name: angola-commerce-platform
description: Hybrid Angola commerce, invoicing and point-of-sale platform

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @angola/web run build
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm --workspace @angola/backend run build && npm --workspace @angola/desktop run build
scripts.android:assemble: npm run cap:sync:android && gradlew.bat -p android assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync:android && gradlew.bat -p android bundleRelease
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync:ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis --linux deb --mac dmg
